lifSubjectList.name: hoursWorkedPerWeek

paraphrase.definition: The upper limit on elapsed time a learner may take to complete the requirements needed to obtain the certification.

paraphrase.definition: Quotient obtained by dividing actual hours performed by the compensable hour ceiling for a full-time post, where that ceiling is set either by statute or by institutional or civil-service rules.

lifSubjectList.name: revoked

lifSubjectList.name: assessmentReportingMethod
lifSubjectList.definition: The method that the instructor of the course uses to report the performance and achievement of all persons. It may be a qualitative method such as individualized teacher comments or a quantitative method such as a letter or a numerical grade. In some cases, more than one type of reporting method may be used.

paraphrase.name: evaluationOutputFormat
paraphrase.definition: The approach an educator applies to convey learner progress and attainment to participants in a class. It can be descriptive, such as personalized narrative feedback, or numeric, such as a letter mark or a score. Sometimes several such approaches are combined for the same offering.

paraphrase.name: maximumEducationalAttainment
